summary: Immaculately presented first-floor apartment offering spacious and modern living throughout. This stylish two bedroom property features a bright and airy lounge, a contemporary fitted kitchen and two well proportioned bedrooms
description:
ENTRANCE HALL On entering, you are greeted by a bright and welcoming hallway complete with intercom entry facilities, setting the tone for the well presented accommodation throughout.

KITCHEN/LIVING AREA The spacious open plan kitchen and living area provides a bright and versatile space, featuring a uPVC Juliet balcony that allows plenty of natural light to flood the room, with ample space for a dining table and seating area. The fully appointed kitchen is fitted with a range of wall and base units, an integrated extractor hood, sink, and plumbing for a washing machine, while the stylish spotlighted ceiling adds a modern finish to the room.

BEDROOM A generously sized double bedroom is located to the rear of the apartment, with ample space for freestanding side tables.

MASTER BEDROOM The impressive master bedroom is bright and spacious, further benefiting from a walk-in wardrobe/dressing room providing excellent storage and dressing space.

BATHROOM The bathroom is fitted with a modern three piece suite comprising a bath with glass shower screen and overhead shower, wash hand basin, and WC, finished in a clean and contemporary style.

EXTERNALLY The property benefits from an allocated car parking space, offering convenient off-street parking. Residents also enjoy access to well maintained communal gardens, providing a pleasant and tranquil outdoor space to relax and enjoy.
